GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and bumped rnr. Prior to correct weight, Stwds considered an objection lodged by rider,  against 1st, alleging interference over the final 100 metres. It was established that approaching the 100m, runner shifted in towards runner. By the 100m, 1st placegetter had obtained a narrow advantage. Over the final 50 metres, 1st placegetter continued to shift in and made contact with runner simultaneously runner to inside shifted out which resulted in runner being momentarily crowded. Considering nature of interference and margin protest was dismissed.
